display.summary: Stored-file and asset fixes: backups stay private in any backup folder, files left beside document files are refused at /media/, and asset clean-up keeps assets that are still in use. Updates now wait for the old web server to stop.
highlights: Stored files: backups in a custom backup folder, .dlb archives anywhere and files a backup record names are never served from /media/.
System Settings refuses a public folder as the backup folder; uploaded restore files get unguessable names.
Stored files: a replaced document file, a project's own history copy or an orphan beside document files is refused at /media/.
Editing or replacing a document's file removes the old file from its folder once the save commits; file history keeps its copy.
dlux_prune_assets --apply and the Asset Manager's Clean up unused keep assets any relation still uses, including trashed records.
Updates and rollbacks wait for the old web server to exit before starting the new one; this takes effect with a rebuilt image.
From 1.15.2 or earlier? This includes the 1.15.3 security fix: afterwards run ./start.sh check --fix (Composer 1.9.2+) so stored files stay private.
